description: This file contains a shell script that tests the behavior of Git's relative GIT_DIR handling, particularly ensuring that post-commit hooks are properly called when the GIT_DIR is moved into a subdirectory and operations are performed from different locations within the working tree. It includes setup of test environments, creation of hooks, and verification of hook execution.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script, finalizing test execution.
